svg.title: Two Arms. Wall rack for a snowboard or skis, white oak

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Two Arms
A wall rack in solid white oak for one snowboard or one pair of skis. Two felt-lined arms, a rail that mounts
to two studs, and a single brine shrimp burned into the oak from the same brass die as the pouch.

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: A 157 cm board resting on the two arms, base to the wall. The rail shows below it.

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: From the side
Six-inch arms, a lip at the end
so nothing rolls off. Skis stand
tails-down on the felt, bases to
the wall; a board lies across.
Rail 30 by 3.5 by 1.25 inches, lag-bolted to two studs.

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Burned in with the heated brass die; the pouch's shrimp at 2.75 inches.
White Oak
oiled, natural
Mountain Navy
powder-coated steel
Forest
wool felt pads
Sego Lily
ash, soaped

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Thirty inches of oak, two arms, one shrimp. It is the thing you screw into the wall of the first apartment

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: after the first season, and it says where you live without saying it.
